Title: Attaining 95-95-95 through Implementation Science: 15 Years of Insights and Best Practices from the Walter Reed Army Institute of Research's Implementation of the U.S. President's Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief.
Exact_Result: Describes WRAIR PEPFAR implementation-science protocols and institutional synergies, without a controlled operational-readiness comparison.

Title: Family-centered preventive intervention for military families: implications for implementation science.
Exact_Result: FOCUS was deployed across military installations; the paper describes implementation conditions and participation rather than comparative outcomes.

Title: Phase angle identifies a muscle quality phenotype associated with physical performance in U.S. marines.
Exact_Result: In 2,177 Marines, PFT increased from 236 to 271 and CFT from 240 to 272 across standardized phase-angle muscle-quality quartiles; models retained sex covariates.

Title: Sex-Specific Cardiovascular Strain During Heat Acclimation in Tactical Athletes.
Exact_Result: Twenty-seven volunteers completed ten heat-acclimation visits; rate-pressure product decreased from day 1 to day 10 under linear mixed models.

Title: Ocular Hypertension and Glaucoma in United States Army Personnel: Barriers to Detection and Impact on Operational Readiness.
Exact_Result: Review outlines military ocular-hypertension detection barriers and suggested strategies; no tested screening effect on readiness is reported.

Title: Prevalence of musculoskeletal disorders among police officers from an organizational unit of a German federal state police force.
Exact_Result: 255 officers reported 92.9% 12-month MSD prevalence; multi-site symptoms were common, but associations are cross-sectional.

Title: Epidemiology of stress fractures among military cadets: a retrospective cohort study at a tertiary military medical center.
Exact_Result: 109 male cadets with diagnosed stress fractures were described; tibia predominated and most were managed conservatively.

Title: Kolb learning styles in Tactical Combat Casualty Care (TCCC): a comparative study of military learners and civilian paramedics.
Exact_Result: 61 participants differed descriptively in Kolb learning-style distributions; authors state no educational effectiveness outcome was assessed.

Title: Recovery outcomes for military personnel undergoing surgery for lumbar spinal stenosis induced by physical overload: a retrospective study.
Exact_Result: Clinical surgical recovery comparisons in 64 servicemen do not address operational-readiness framework claims.

Title: Behavioral health technician delivered written exposure therapy for posttraumatic stress disorder in the military: Design of a hybrid implementation effectiveness trial.
Exact_Result: The article specifies planned BHT-delivered written exposure therapy versus treatment as usual; results are not reported.

Title: Addressing PTSD symptoms in first responders and healthcare workers through trauma-focused treatment in Employee Assistance Programs: Protocol for a randomized controlled trial.
Exact_Result: Protocol plans PE-PC versus treatment-as-usual; effectiveness and implementation outcomes are not yet reported.

Title: Nutrition for Tactical Athletes: Insights, Applications and Research Gaps.
Exact_Result: Narrative synthesis adapts sport nutrition principles; it does not provide a pooled tactical-effect estimate.

Title: Development of a military mental health training program aiming to promote mental health and operational readiness in the Danish armed forces: an intervention mapping approach.
Exact_Result: The Danish program is a development roadmap; it has not demonstrated improved mental health or operational readiness.

Title: Efficacy of Fatigue Countermeasures on Cognitive Performance and Operational Safety in Military Pilots: A Systematic Review.
Exact_Result: The article narrates short-term pharmacological findings but does not expose sufficient review methods or study-level evidence for a stronger claim.

Title: Psychological stress and physiological outcomes: investigating the impact of attention biases and emotional regulation in Chinese military service members.
Exact_Result: N=673; stress correlated with negative attention r=0.335 and expressive inhibition r=0.269, and inversely with positive attention r=-0.159 and cognitive reappraisal r=-0.162 (all p<0.001); resilience correlation was not significant.

Title: Low Energy Availability Prevalence, Dietary Habits, and Sleep in Female Army ROTC Cadets.
Exact_Result: Four of ten met the study LEA threshold and five more were suboptimal; only two met the Army sleep recommendation.

Title: Efficacy and acceptability of different blood flow restriction training interventions during the rehabilitation of military personnel with lower limb musculoskeletal injuries: protocol for a two-phase randomised controlled trial.
Exact_Result: Protocol plans N=28 then N=26 and explicitly lacks long-term follow-up; it reports no efficacy or acceptability result.

Title: Toward promoting performance nutrition behaviors among tactical athletes: a mixed methods study.
Exact_Result: Ten completers reported energy intake at 46% and 53% of estimated requirements in weeks 1 and 17; focus-group themes identified time and food-access barriers.

Title: Hazardous alcohol use and cardiometabolic risk among firefighters.
Exact_Result: N=2,405; high AUDIT-C was associated with higher total cholesterol and blood pressure after stated adjustments, while VO2peak and peak power did not differ.

Title: US Army Accession and Retention Standards: Impact on Obesity and Medical Readiness.
Exact_Result: NHANES modelling found 29-50% of men and 39-50% of women failed current standards across age groups; results are not observed readiness outcomes.

Title: Methodology used to develop the minimum common data elements for surveillance and Reporting of Musculoskeletal Injuries in the MILitary (ROMMIL) statement.
Exact_Result: The methods paper reports 95, 65, and 42 respondents across Delphi rounds and documents limitations; the primary checklist is reported separately.

Title: Acute exercise impacts heart rate variability but not cognitive flexibility during subsequent simulated firefighter occupational tasks.
Exact_Result: N=29; total, perseverative, and non-perseverative errors did not differ by condition (all p>0.39); aerobic exercise lowered one HRV frequency-domain measure.

Title: Decision-making during training of a Swedish navy command and control team: a quantitative study of workload effects.
Exact_Result: N=10; NASA-TLX workload did not differ significantly between simulation settings.

Title: Combat readiness, alcohol abuse, and posttraumatic stress disorder among Uganda peoples' defence forces soldiers.
Exact_Result: Among 150 UPDF soldiers, 24 screened positive for PTSD (16%); results are screening data, not clinical diagnosis or causal effects.

Title: Nutrition as a military capability to deliver human advantage: more people, more ready, more of the time.
Exact_Result: Framework article provides no study-level effect estimate.

Title: Barriers and enablers to implementing police mental health co-responder programs: A qualitative study using the consolidated framework for implementation research.
Exact_Result: Interviews included six clinicians, two clinical managers, 15 police officers and seven station leaders; effectiveness was not evaluated.

Title: Examining how organizational leaders perceive internet-delivered cognitive behavioural therapy for public safety personnel using the RE-AIM implementation framework.
Exact_Result: N=10 organizational leaders discussed reach, adoption and implementation perceptions under RE-AIM.

Title: Group brief cognitive behavioral therapy for suicide prevention compared to dialectal behavior therapy skills group for military service members: a study protocol of a randomized controlled trial.
Exact_Result: Protocol describes a planned two-arm randomized comparison and no efficacy results.

Title: Contributions from incumbent police officer's physical activity and body composition to occupational assessment performance.
Exact_Result: N=30 incumbent officers; cross-sectional analysis relates measured characteristics to a Physical Readiness Assessment.

Title: Pre-neuromusculoskeletal injury Risk factor Evaluation and Post-neuromusculoskeletal injury Assessment for Return-to-duty/activity Enhancement (PREPARE) in military service members: a prospective, observational study protocol.
Exact_Result: Protocol describes phased observational assessment development; results are NR.

Title: Body composition of extreme performers in the US Marine Corps.
Exact_Result: Descriptive US Marine Corps body-composition findings.

Title: Nutrition Program Fidelity Assessment tool: a framework for optimising implementation in military dining facilities.
Exact_Result: Framework proposes fidelity assessment.

Title: International society of sports nutrition position stand: tactical athlete nutrition.
Exact_Result: Position stand synthesizes nutrition considerations.

Title: Body Composition, Eicosapentaenoic Acid, and Vitamin D are Associated with Army Combat Fitness Test Performance.
Exact_Result: Associational ACFT analysis; no causal intervention tested.

Title: Cognitive Resilience to Psychological Stress in Military Personnel.
Exact_Result: Study examines cognitive responses to stress.

Title: Evaluating the Tactical Combat Casualty Care principles in civilian and military settings: systematic review, knowledge gap analysis and recommendations for future research.
Exact_Result: Clinical TCCC review.

Title: Fractures and Chronic Recurrence are Commonly Associated with Ankle Sprains: a 5-year Population-level Cohort of Patients Seen in the U.S. Military Health System.
Exact_Result: Five-year population-level cohort.

Title: Effects of foam rolling for delayed onset muscle soreness on loaded military task performance and perceived recovery.
Exact_Result: Task-performance and recovery outcomes reported in a short intervention study.

Title: The relationship between vitamin D status and depression in a tactical athlete population.
Exact_Result: Cross-sectional association.

Title: Implementation interventions for musculoskeletal programs of care in the active military and barriers, facilitators, and outcomes of implementation: a scoping review.
Exact_Result: Scoping review maps evidence.

Title: Risk factors for back pain in marines; a prospective cohort study.
Exact_Result: Prospective cohort reports risk factors.
